cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Confess Around Them
cards.instruction: Use partial admissions to make a reciprocal confession feel like the only missing piece.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I hid the first complaint letter. Where did the second go? I taught you to keep every envelope with its date on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And I'm putting it on the table. You've learnt to notice an omission; good. Now fill in the gap after mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There was a third letter, too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll tell you where I kept the first: under the accounts. Put the other two beside it, in the order I taught you, and tell me which one you kept from me.
